title: Full Stack with Code Apps
summary: More code, more problems. How to give makers AI coding tools safely, and how the data boundary decides between Copilot Managed Runtime, Power Platform + Dataverse, and Azure.
whyItMatters: Provides a decision rule and safety model for AI-generated apps.

keyPoints.heading: Less code, fewer problems
keyPoints.text: Keep code small; hand off what you can to Microsoft; low code uses few primitives.

keyPoints.heading: Five layers of an AI coding tool
keyPoints.text: Model, context, harness (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code), runtime (local or cloud container like Codespaces), client (frontend).

keyPoints.heading: Instructions are a wish, not a rule
keyPoints.text: AGENTS.md always on; skills/MCP/plugins loaded when needed; TALXIS skills repo as an alternative.

keyPoints.heading: Hosts
keyPoints.text: Power Pages, model-driven, canvas, code apps; primary choice model-driven with PCF; push business logic into Dataverse (plug-ins, custom APIs).

keyPoints.heading: Data boundary decides
keyPoints.text: Public/non-classified, no audit: CMR. Must contain and audit: Power Platform + Dataverse. Can't host: Azure. Don't mix: frontend and backend drift.

keyPoints.heading: Code apps
keyPoints.text: Power Apps SDK (@microsoft/power-apps), generated data services, power.config.json, Power Apps host; code lives in GitHub; admins govern via CSP.

keyPoints.heading: Deployment
keyPoints.text: End-to-end CI/CD with GitHub PR workflows.
